说明具体变更及其任务编号。

## Validation / 验证

- Commands and outcomes / 命令与结果：
- Fixtures or real artifacts used / 使用的样例或真实产物：

## Handoff / 交接

- [ ] Changed only this project's files; no data, weights or credentials committed. / 仅变更本项目，无数据权重凭据误提交。
- [ ] Code, contracts, docs and meaningful tests agree. / 代码、契约、文档与必要测试一致。
- [ ] Implemented behavior is distinguished from scaffolding and planned work. / 明确区分已实现、骨架和计划。
- [ ] Test seals and training ownership remain intact. / 测试封存和训练归属保持有效。
- [ ] Real metrics reference run/manifests; fixture checks are not quality claims. / 真实指标可追溯，样例检查不当效果成绩。
- [ ] Task status, remaining limitations and next action updated. / 已更新状态、局限及下一步。
